no-raw-colors.rationale: Every colour is a token. Raw hex or Tailwind palette colours break theming and the warm Meridian palette.

no-arbitrary-values.rationale: Spacing, radius and type come from the scale. If the scale lacks a step, add a token instead of an arbitrary value.

no-inline-styles.rationale: Inline styles bypass tokens and cannot be themed.

no-restyle.rationale: Pick a variant instead of overriding a component's own look with className.

contracts.message: Use variant and size; do not recolour Button.
Use the variant prop for elevation.
